comment: Ruby numbers with `r` and `i` suffixes, like `3/4r`, `3i` or `1.5ri`. The builtin Ruby grammar does not scope them at all, so they stay uncolored. Remove this when https://github.com/textmate/ruby.tmbundle supports them.

patterns.comment: Only `i` is allowed after an exponent: `1e3i` is valid, `1e3r` is not
patterns.name: constant.numeric.ruby
